The pass was earned on the build of 2026-09-07 before that day's fixes landed, and two of them are in this check's path: ISS-0011 changed what the served page gets while a sidecar is still indexing, which is the tablet opening a large workspace, and ISS-0014 changed what Deck's host forwards, which is the refusal this check asserts.

The pass carried the walker's own doubt, 'I am not sure if it doesn't leave anything running when I quit???', and the doubt was right: ISS-0021 fixed the quit twice after that mark was recorded, once for the window quit and once for a quit that arrives as a signal.
